hooks.command: export AGNOSTIC_AI_TARGET=codex; sh -c 'root="$PWD"; root="$(cd "$root" && pwd)" || exit 1; dir="$root"; while :; do if [ -f "$dir/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] || [ -f "$dir/agnostic.config.yaml" ]; then root="$dir"; break; fi; parent="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ "$parent" = "$dir" ]; then root="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; break; fi; dir="$parent"; done; bin=agnostic-ai; if [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ]; then bin="$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai"; else command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; fi; AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 "$bin" project --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agnostic-ai: upgrade the selected package to a release supporting project; update its declared version and requires explicitly" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$bin" project -- hook memory --target codex'
hooks.commandWindows: $root = (Get-Location).Path; $dir = $root; while ($true) { if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'agnostic-ai.yaml') -PathType Leaf) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'agnostic.config.yaml') -PathType Leaf)) { $root = $dir; break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if (!$parent -or $parent -eq $dir) { $top = git -C $root rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if (!$top) { exit 0 }; $root = $top; break }; $dir = $parent }; $local = Join-Path $root 'node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai.cmd'; $bin = 'agnostic-ai'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $local) { $bin = $local } elseif (!(Get-Command agnostic-ai -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }; $env:AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK = '1'; & $bin project --help *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('agnostic-ai: upgrade the selected package to a release supporting project; update its declared version and requires explicitly'); exit 1 }; & $bin project -- hook memory --target codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE
